economicBenchmarks: SPY buy-and-hold over the same calendar, plus matched nonoverlapping H126 SPY books to expose cash-gap opportunity cost

sourceWindow.archiveGranularity: whole content-addressed monthly price/action objects may include KR and other securities; only admitted US rows through the through-date are used

returnInterpretation: cash dividends reinvested at ex-date close on split-consistent shares, gross of tax; as-traded prices recovered from replay-v16 using its event recipe. Raw-price/action context needs admission; retrospective data/identity remain conditional
sizeDefinition: filed weighted-average share count x recovered as-traded close, no crossing split; explicitly a size proxy
baseline: current operating/OCF margins + 252-session momentum + log size proxy
augmentation: baseline plus four B state-change fields; same eligible sample
calibration: last 20% of mature training signal dates; proper-fit labels strictly mature/released before calibration starts; fixed train-only Platt; no refit on calibration/2020
labels: same signal-date resolved eligible cohort deciles, ties included; winner top10% AND excess>0, big_loss bottom10% AND excess<0; unresolved is never neutral
labelRelease: after H126 close+60min; late terminal evidence is unresolved at this fixed publication boundary
controlMatching: same signal/industry/size tercile fixed before outcomes; report unresolved controls separately
portfolio: nonoverlapping H126 Top5 books; next session close; first complete weekly signal at/after liquidation starts next book; cash gaps and final 2020-origin cohort runout explicit
ranking: raw logistic P(win)-P(big_loss), Ridge excess; ties by canonical admitted ticker (rename/reuse categories excluded); forced diagnostic Top5, not a buy recommendation
costs: existing benchmark_alpha US: commission5bps, spread6bps, sellTax0.3bps; us_decision_pilot self-financing simulation
terminalCashCosts: certified mandatory cash redemption has no discretionary sell trade; terminal cash held unremunerated; endpoint returns may resolve while daily MDD remains unresolved
